title: Wan 2.2 text to video
description: Silent text-to-video from a prompt. Downloads open weights on first start (about 38 GB) and returns an mp4. No audio model.

input.name: Frame interpolation
input.description: Double the frame rate after sampling. Off encodes at 16 fps.

input.name: Hugging Face token
input.description: Optional. The default weights are public. A token raises the Hub rate limit.

input.name: Model directory
input.description: Where weights are stored. Point this at a network volume to avoid a fresh download on every cold start.

input.name: Skip model download
input.description: Turn on only when MODEL_DIR already contains the weights.

input.name: Download optional LoRAs
input.description: Also fetch the v2.0 and 250928 Lightning pairs. About 6 GB more.

input.name: High-noise LoRA filename
input.description: Filename inside models/loras. Must be the high-noise half of the same pair as the low-noise file.

input.name: Low-noise LoRA filename
input.description: Filename inside models/loras. Must be the low-noise half of the same pair as the high-noise file.

input.name: Return mp4 in the response
input.description: Turn off only when S3 is configured and you do not want the bytes inline.

input.name: S3 endpoint URL
input.description: Optional. Leave empty to return the mp4 inline. Set all four S3 variables or none.

input.name: S3 bucket
input.description: Bucket that receives the mp4 when S3 is configured.

input.name: S3 access key
input.description: Access key for the bucket above.

input.name: S3 secret key
input.description: Secret key for the bucket above.

input.name: Public URL base
input.description: Optional base for video_url, with no trailing slash. When empty, the endpoint and bucket name are used.

input.name: S3 region
input.description: Region passed to the S3 client.

input.name: Max duration (seconds)
input.description: Longest clip the worker will accept. The model is trained around 5 seconds.
